forbidden.comment: Circular dependencies make code unpredictable and hard to test.
forbidden.name: no-circular

forbidden.comment: core/ must not know how it is triggered (no commands, no modules). Invert the dependency or move shared shapes to core/.
forbidden.name: core-no-application

forbidden.comment: Application layer orchestrates core; must not reach directly into infrastructure adapters. The CLI module is the composition root — it wires everything.
forbidden.name: app-no-infrastructure

forbidden.comment: infrastructure/ adapters must not import application/ or core/ — they sit at the edge.
forbidden.name: infrastructure-no-upward-deps

forbidden.comment: Every module in src must be reachable from the entry point (dead-code guard).
forbidden.name: no-unreachable-from-entry

forbidden.comment: Orphan modules are dead-code candidates (allow type declarations and entry points).
forbidden.name: no-orphans

forbidden.comment: Production code must not import devDependencies (type-only imports are compiled away and allowed).
forbidden.name: not-to-dev-dep

forbidden.comment: Every import from src must resolve to a dependency declared in package.json.
forbidden.name: no-non-package-json
